note: Counts and dates for what each NDJSON file in this directory holds. CI cross-checks these numbers against the file and against the built index, so a drop that lost records fails the publish instead of quietly shipping.

wordpress.coverageNote: browse=new is the only sort that enumerates the directory exactly; browse=popular ties on active_installs and yields 50,126 distinct slugs of a claimed 64,947. Duplicates come from plugins added mid-run shifting the offsets, which repeats records rather than skipping them.

joomla.source: extensions.joomla.org Algolia index (jed_live), enumerated in 287 core_catid slices
joomla.coverageNote: The directory reports 5,610 and all 5,610 were fetched. Six are not published because JED declares no extension type for them - their Includes badge row is empty on the listing page itself - and kind is a required field with no honest default. They are named in data/joomla.export-report.json. Algolia caps pagination at 1,000 hits and refuses the browse endpoint to a search-only key, so paging the index straight through returns 1,000 of 5,610 with an HTTP 200 for every request; core_catid partitions the index exactly and every slice fits under the cap.

notMeasured.shopify: No census has been run for the Shopify app store yet. The crawler exists (ecosystem-crawler/discover/fetch-shopify-apps.py) and the store rate-limits hard, so the run is scheduled rather than immediate.

sources.directory-reported: published by the marketplace itself, usually in buckets

excluded.note: Descriptions, changelogs and marketing copy belong to the extension authors and are not republished. Metrics obtained under a commercial licence are not published, and no data supplier is named anywhere in the output.
